author: John Hammond
description:
This phishing page is pretty rough... but the email behind it is a lot more interesting.

The attackers are using legitimate Facebook emails with personalized details to make the scam feel convincing. It is a good reminder that even authentic emails can be abused to build trust.

Watch the full breakdown here: https://youtu.be/QRN3t1_paTY?si=A-BZoQ4FI9qb-RFF
title: Facebook Phishing Fails
